items.title: A new approach to AI data puts communities in charge
items.summary: Tags: Accessibility Community partnerships The post A new approach to AI data puts communities in charge appeared first on Source .
items.summaryZh: 人工智能数据的新方法让社区负责。人工智能对世界的了解大部分来自大多数人从未见过的数据，以及决定包含或排除内容的技术流程。随着人工智能在日常生活中的影响力越来越大，一个新平台旨在帮助社区参与幕后建立的基础，以确保他们得到准确和公平的描绘，尤其是在图像方面。

items.title: Open models recap: more on Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8, Xi's WAIC speech, distillation, the open-closed gap, and what's next
items.summary: Exciting news! My book trying to share post-training knowledge with the world is done and shipping soon. Order on Manning or Amazon . Thanks for the support. It’s currently the #1 AI book on Amazon :). Nathan and Florian sit down to discuss everything happening with open models. Following the Kimi K3 release last week, it feels like everything is accelerating — geopolitics of US v China, economics of open vs. closed
items.summaryZh: 本文来自Interconnects，围绕“Open models recap: more on Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8, Xi's WAIC speech, distillation, the open-closed gap, and what's next”介绍模型发布方面的最新进展，重点涉及Qwen、模型发布。下方为系统保存的原文正文。

items.title: How Thinking Machines Lab’s Inkling performs on agentic knowledge work
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab’s Inkling scores an Elo of 836 on on our agentic knowledge work benchmark AA-Briefcase
items.summaryZh: # Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 在代理知识工作上的表现 Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 在我们的代理知识工作基准 AA-Briefcase 上的 Elo 得分为 836，领先于 DeepSeek V4 Flash，但低于包括 Nemotron 3 Ultra 和 GLM-5.2 在内的领先开放权重模型。我们新的代理知识工作基准 AA-Briefcase 在数千个输入文件中的实际任务上测试模型，需要诸如电子表格、演示文稿和 UI 模型。
